contextThreshold.label: Context Threshold
contextThreshold.help: Fraction of context window that triggers compaction (0.0–1.0)

incrementalMaxDepth.label: Incremental Max Depth
incrementalMaxDepth.help: How deep incremental compaction goes (0 = leaf only, -1 = unlimited)

freshTailCount.label: Fresh Tail Count
freshTailCount.help: Number of recent messages protected from compaction

mongodbUri.label: MongoDB URI
mongodbUri.help: MongoDB connection URI (used when storageBackend is mongodb)

searchIndexMessages.label: Atlas Search Index (Messages)
searchIndexMessages.help: Atlas Search full-text index name for messages (default: lcm_messages_search)

searchIndexSummaries.label: Atlas Search Index (Summaries)
searchIndexSummaries.help: Atlas Search full-text index name for summaries (default: lcm_summaries_search)

vectorSearchIndexMessages.label: Vector Search Index (Messages)
vectorSearchIndexMessages.help: Atlas Vector Search index name for messages (default: lcm_messages_vector)

vectorSearchIndexSummaries.label: Vector Search Index (Summaries)
vectorSearchIndexSummaries.help: Atlas Vector Search index name for summaries (default: lcm_summaries_vector)

autoCreateAtlasIndexes.label: Auto-Create Atlas Indexes
autoCreateAtlasIndexes.help: When true, create Atlas Search and Vector Search indexes if not already present (MongoDB only)

voyageApiKey.label: Voyage API Key
voyageApiKey.help: Atlas Model API key for manual embeddings when auto-embedding is not supported. See https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/management/api-keys/

summaryModel.label: Summary Model
summaryModel.help: Model override for LCM summarization (e.g., 'gpt-5.4' or 'openai-resp/gpt-5.4')
